title: DesyncFSM cannot execute normative recovery timeout transition
description: python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py implements DESYNCED->RECOVERING and the three-valid-beacon transition, but has no timeout API/timer transition for the normative RECOVERING + timeout -> DESYNCED rule in spec/09-packets-timing.md section 14.7. TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES is defined but unused. Add an explicit bounded timeout/missed-superframe transition that resets consecutive_valid, and vector-driven tests for timeout at each recovery count.
